requirement_text: The system shall be able to do the authentication process for login and payment through bankcard.
user_story: As a customer, I want to authenticate with my bankcard for login and payment, so that I can sign in and pay securely.
technical_task: Implement bankcard-based authentication for the login and payment processes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid bankcard, when the user logs in with it, then the user is authenticated.
Given a valid bankcard, when the user pays with it, then the payment is authenticated.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The authentication method for the card is not specified.

requirement_text: The THEMAS system shall be able to generate and record an event when a heating or cooling request is denied.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to generate and record an event when a heating or cooling request is denied, so that denials can be reviewed.
technical_task: Create and store an event whenever a heating or cooling request is denied.
acceptance_criteria: Given a heating request is denied, when the denial occurs, then an event is generated and recorded.
Given a cooling request is denied, when the denial occurs, then an event is generated and recorded.

requirement_text: All letter requests must be formatted according to guidelines specified by the Print Letter Utility system.
user_story: As a clerk, I want all letter requests formatted according to the Print Letter Utility guidelines, so that letters print correctly.
technical_task: Format every letter request to follow the guidelines specified by the Print Letter Utility system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a letter request, when it is formatted, then it follows the guidelines of the Print Letter Utility system.
Given a letter request that does not follow the guidelines, when it is submitted, then it is not accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: clerk. The guidelines are not quoted.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability for attestation of attestable EMR content by the content's author.
user_story: As an author, I want to attest EMR content that I wrote, so that it is marked as verified by me.
technical_task: Let the content's author attest attestable EMR content.
acceptance_criteria: Given attestable EMR content, when its author attests it, then the attestation is recorded.
Given attestable EMR content, when someone other than its author tries to attest it, then the attestation is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician author. The second criterion follows from "by the content's author".

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide an API call which allows the application to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR should be used for telemetry and/or command reception.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall (3.3.11.8) provide an API call which allows the application to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR should be used for telemetry and/or command reception.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR are used for telemetry and/or command reception, so that I can select channels.
technical_task: Expose an FTSS API call through which an application chooses the MPCC channels of a C&T FCR used for telemetry and/or command reception.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application, when it calls the FTSS API with MPCC channels of a C&T FCR, then those channels are used for telemetry and/or command reception.
Given the FTSS API, when the application calls it, then the channels can be specified for telemetry, command reception or both.

requirement_text: System shall prioritize user-friendly interfaces for easy navigation and data entry.
rationale: "User-friendly" and "easy" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes an interface "user-friendly" in measurable terms?
Which navigation and data entry tasks does this cover?

requirement_text: The system shall enforce strong password management, requiring users to keep passwords confidential and unique for each service.
user_story: As a user, I want strong password management that keeps my passwords confidential and unique for each service, so that my accounts are safe.
technical_task: Enforce password rules that require users to keep passwords confidential and to use a unique password for each service.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user sets a password for a service, when the password matches one used for another service, then it is rejected.
Given a user sets a unique password, when it is saved, then it is accepted and stored confidentially.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Strong" is not defined; the criteria cover uniqueness and confidentiality.

requirement_text: All messages passed between CMCS system layers shall have both UTC and wall clock time stamp information appropriate for the message type.
user_story: As a system engineer, I want every message between CMCS system layers to carry UTC and wall clock time stamps suited to its type, so that messages can be ordered.
technical_task: Attach both a UTC time stamp and a wall clock time stamp, appropriate for the message type, to every message passed between CMCS system layers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message passed between CMCS system layers, when it is sent, then it carries a UTC time stamp.
Given a message passed between CMCS system layers, when it is sent, then it also carries a wall clock time stamp appropriate for its type.

requirement_text: System shall be able to display a No results found message when no search results are found.
user_story: As a user, I want to see a No results found message when my search finds nothing, so that I know the search worked.
technical_task: Display "No results found" when a search returns no results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search with no matching results, when the search completes, then a No results found message is displayed.
Given a search with matching results, when the search completes, then the results are shown and the message is not displayed.

requirement_text: System shall ensure compatibility with various data formats and standards for interoperability.
rationale: "Various data formats and standards" are not named.
clarification_questions: Which data formats and standards must be supported?

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , if alignment is permitted, serially incorporate two new channels if they are powered on simultaneously.
requirement_text_raw: 2.     Redundancy Management shall [SRS236], if alignment is permitted, serially incorporate two new channels if they are powered on simultaneously.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to incorporate two newly powered channels one after the other when alignment is permitted, so that they join in order.
technical_task: When alignment is permitted and two new channels are powered on at the same time, incorporate them serially.
acceptance_criteria: Given alignment is permitted and two new channels are powered on simultaneously, when Redundancy Management incorporates them, then it incorporates them one after another.
Given alignment is not permitted, when two new channels are powered on, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The system shall display user-friendly, one-click selectable results in the list view.
user_story: As a user, I want results in the list view that I can select with one click, so that I can open them quickly.
technical_task: Make each result in the list view selectable with a single click.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list view, when results are displayed, then each result can be selected.
Given a result in the list view, when the user clicks it once, then it is selected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "User-friendly" is read as one-click selection.

requirement_text: No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.
user_story: As a claims manager, I want only users with an adjuster role to request recycled parts audits, so that audits are controlled.
technical_task: Allow only users with the adjuster role to request recycled parts audits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit, then the request is accepted.
Given a user without the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit, then the request is refused.

requirement_text: The TCS shall receive, process, and present payload data to the operator so that the status of the payload can be determined.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want the TCS to receive, process and present payload data, so that I can determine the status of the payload.
technical_task: Receive and process payload data in the TCS and show it to the operator.
acceptance_criteria: Given payload data, when the TCS receives it, then it is processed.
Given processed payload data, when the operator opens the display, then the data is presented so the payload status can be determined.

requirement_text: Secure connection to an internal system shall be required for user login and identification.
user_story: As a user, I want a secure connection to an internal system for login and identification, so that my credentials are protected.
technical_task: Require a secure connection to the internal system for login and user identification.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user logs in, when the system connects to the internal system, then the connection is secure.
Given a connection that is not secure, when a user tries to log in, then login is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The type of secure connection is not specified.

requirement_text: Database keys connections passwords or other secrets are not stored in plain text.
requirement_text_raw: Database keys  connections  passwords  or other secrets are not stored in plain text.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want database keys, connections, passwords and other secrets never stored in plain text, so that they cannot be read if storage is exposed.
technical_task: Store database keys, connections, passwords and other secrets only in protected form.
acceptance_criteria: Given a secret such as a password, when it is stored, then it is not stored in plain text.
Given stored secrets, when the storage is inspected, then none is readable in plain text.

requirement_text: The product shall interface with the ChoiceParts system once per day at approximately 1:00 AM.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall interface with the ChoiceParts system once per day at approximately 1:00 AM.'
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the product to interface with the ChoiceParts system once per day at approximately 1:00 AM, so that data stays in sync.
technical_task: Schedule a daily interface run with the ChoiceParts system at approximately 1:00 AM.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal day, when the time reaches approximately 1:00 AM, then the product interfaces with the ChoiceParts system.
Given a single day, when the interface has run, then it does not run again until the next day.

requirement_text: Memory alignment shall reset the watchdog timer such that, in the absence of a fault, the timer never expires and resets the processor.
requirement_text_raw: Memory alignment shall [SRS294] reset the watchdog timer such that, in the absence of a fault, the timer never expires and resets the processor.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory alignment to reset the watchdog timer so that it never expires without a fault, so that the processor is not reset needlessly.
technical_task: Have memory alignment reset the watchdog timer so that, with no fault, the timer does not expire and reset the processor.
acceptance_criteria: Given no fault is present, when memory alignment runs, then the watchdog timer is reset.
Given no fault is present, when time passes, then the watchdog timer never expires and the processor is not reset.

requirement_text: FTSS shall route messages to the proper virtual group(s) and socket.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS227] route messages to the proper virtual group(s) and socket.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to route messages to the proper virtual group or groups and socket, so that messages reach their destination.
technical_task: Route each message to the correct virtual group(s) and socket inside FTSS.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message addressed to a virtual group and socket, when FTSS routes it, then it is delivered to that virtual group and socket.
Given a message addressed to several virtual groups, when FTSS routes it, then it is delivered to each of them.

requirement_text: Additionally, FDIR shall reinitialize and integrate the NE.
requirement_text_raw: Additionally, FDIR shall (3.3.5.25) reinitialize and integrate the NE.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to reinitialize and integrate the NE, so that the NE rejoins the system.
technical_task: Have FDIR reinitialize the NE and then integrate it back into the configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE that needs recovery, when FDIR acts, then the NE is reinitialized.
Given a reinitialized NE, when FDIR continues, then the NE is integrated.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "Additionally" refers to preceding requirements not shown.

requirement_text: System shall display related items to the items already bought by the user.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to see items related to those I already bought, so that I can discover what goes with them.
technical_task: Recommend items related to the user's previous purchases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has bought items, when the user opens the recommendations, then items related to the bought items are displayed.
Given a user with no purchases, when the user opens the recommendations, then no purchase-based items are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. How items are related is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall utilize a video splitter to divide large video files into smaller chunks for efficient processing within the system.
user_story: As a video editor, I want large video files split into smaller chunks, so that they are processed efficiently.
technical_task: Add a video splitter that divides large video files into smaller chunks before processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large video file, when it is processed, then the video splitter divides it into smaller chunks.
Given the chunks, when processing runs, then each chunk is processed within the system.
rationale: Role assumed: video editor. What counts as large is not stated.

requirement_text: Recreation of Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the period of previous 30 days shall take no more than 30min.
requirement_text_raw: Recreation of Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the period of previous 30 days shall take no more than 30min.'
user_story: As an inventory manager, I want to recreate an Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the previous 30 days in no more than 30min, so that I can fix records quickly.
technical_task: Limit recreation of the Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the previous 30 days to 30min.
acceptance_criteria: Given the previous 30 days of data, when the Inventory Quantity Adjustment is recreated, then it takes no more than 30min.
Given a recreation that takes longer than 30min, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Now you will see a block of available time slots for that provider's schedule.
rationale: The sentence reads as help text and says "Now" without context.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an instruction to the user?
What must the system show for the provider's schedule?

requirement_text: The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall achieve a 98\% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2\% of the available online time.'
user_story: As a user, I want the product to achieve 98% uptime and fail for no more than 2% of the available online time, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Meet 98% uptime and keep failures within 2% of the available online time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a measurement period, when uptime is calculated, then it is at least 98%.
Given the available online time, when failures are summed, then they are no more than 2% of it.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The measurement period is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to translate EML datasets to Data Packages.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to translate EML datasets to Data Packages, so that I can publish them in that format.
technical_task: Implement a conversion from EML datasets to Data Packages.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EML dataset, when the user starts the translation, then a Data Package is produced.
Given a produced Data Package, when it is compared with the EML dataset, then it contains the same dataset content.
rationale: Role assumed: data publisher. Content equivalence is an interpretation of "translate".

requirement_text: The Scheduler shall support three rate groups: 50 Hz (minor frame), 10 Hz (medium frame), and 1 Hz (major frame).
requirement_text_raw: The Scheduler shall (3.3.4.1) support three rate groups: 50 Hz (minor frame), 10 Hz (medium frame), and 1 Hz (major frame).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Scheduler to support three rate groups: 50 Hz (minor frame), 10 Hz (medium frame) and 1 Hz (major frame), so that tasks run at the right rates.
technical_task: Implement three rate groups in the Scheduler: 50 Hz as the minor frame, 10 Hz as the medium frame and 1 Hz as the major frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Scheduler, when a task is assigned to the 50 Hz rate group, then it runs once per minor frame.
Given the Scheduler, when tasks are assigned to the 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups, then they run once per medium frame and once per major frame respectively.

requirement_text: Click 'Expand' next to the desired Encounter to view it's details.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Expand next to an Encounter to see its details, so that I can review the encounter.
technical_task: Add an Expand control next to each Encounter that shows its details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of Encounters, when the user clicks Expand next to one, then its details are shown.
Given an expanded Encounter, when the user views it, then the details of only that Encounter are shown.

requirement_text: Interaction between users must be secured to maintain privacy.
rationale: "Interaction between users" and "secured" are too general to turn into testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What kinds of interaction between users are meant?
What does "secured" require (encryption, authentication, access control)?

requirement_text: If IBIT fails, the FTSS SW shall handle the failure as stated in the preceding IBIT requirements and in requirement 3.3.5.29’s table, FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms.
requirement_text_raw: If IBIT fails, the FTSS SW shall (3.3.2.41) handle the failure as stated in the preceding IBIT requirements and in requirement 3.3.5.29’s table, FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to handle an IBIT failure as stated in the preceding IBIT requirements and the requirement 3.3.5.29 table, so that failures get the defined response.
technical_task: Handle an IBIT failure in the FTSS SW as set out in the preceding IBIT requirements and in the table FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms of requirement 3.3.5.29.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT fails, when the FTSS SW handles the failure, then it follows the preceding IBIT requirements.
Given IBIT fails, when the FTSS SW handles the failure, then it follows the table FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms in requirement 3.3.5.29.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The referenced table is not shown.

requirement_text: The system shall perform a search on the [system name] user display name and user name columns in the user tables to find the user and verify the user’s existence.
rationale: The text contains an unfilled placeholder, "[system name]".
clarification_questions: What is the actual system name, given "[system name]" is a placeholder?
Which tables and columns are meant?

requirement_text: The scheduler shall provide an API call for an FCP application task to alert the scheduler of a vehicle mode change.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS019] provide an API call for an FCP application task to alert the scheduler of a vehicle mode change.
user_story: As an application developer, I want a scheduler API call to tell the scheduler of a vehicle mode change from an FCP application task, so that scheduling follows the mode.
technical_task: Provide a scheduler API call that an FCP application task uses to notify the scheduler of a vehicle mode change.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP application task, when it calls the API to report a vehicle mode change, then the scheduler is alerted.
Given the scheduler is alerted, when it processes the change, then it knows the vehicle mode has changed.

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein after being subjected to a total of six impact shocks, consisting of six shocks (one in each opposite direction) along each of three orthogonal axes.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.4.1) be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein after being subjected to a total of six impact shocks, consisting of six shocks (one in each opposite direction) along each of three orthogonal axes.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE to meet its performance requirements after six impact shocks, one in each opposite direction along each of three orthogonal axes, so that it survives launch handling.
technical_task: Design the flight NE to comply with all performance requirements after a total of six impact shocks, one in each direction along each of three orthogonal axes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE has been subjected to a total of six impact shocks, one in each opposite direction along each of three orthogonal axes, when its performance is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.
Given the flight NE after the shocks, when a performance requirement is checked, then it is met.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The reason (launch handling) is inferred.

requirement_text: Once every medium frame, the FTSS software shall accept a pointer from the telemetry program to the buffer space containing the telemetry data.
requirement_text_raw: Once every medium frame, the FTSS software shall (3.4.2.3) accept a pointer from the telemetry program to the buffer space containing the telemetry data.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS software to accept a pointer to the telemetry buffer from the telemetry program once every medium frame, so that telemetry data can be exchanged.
technical_task: Accept, once per medium frame, a pointer from the telemetry program to the buffer holding the telemetry data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a medium frame, when the telemetry program provides a pointer to the buffer space, then the FTSS software accepts it.
Given consecutive medium frames, when they run, then the pointer is accepted once in each frame.

requirement_text: User shall be informed about system failures through error messages displayed on the main screen.
user_story: As a user, I want to see error messages on the main screen when the system fails, so that I know something is wrong.
technical_task: Show system failure notifications as error messages on the main screen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system failure, when it occurs, then an error message is displayed on the main screen.
Given no system failure, when the user views the main screen, then no failure message is displayed.

requirement_text: In case that the electronics for isolation measurement failed, a worst case value less than 100 Ohm / Volt is assumed (internal and external).
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want a worst case value of less than 100 Ohm / Volt to be assumed when the electronics for isolation measurement fail, so that safety is preserved.
technical_task: Assume a worst case isolation value of less than 100 Ohm / Volt, internal and external, when the isolation measurement electronics have failed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the electronics for isolation measurement have failed, when the isolation value is needed, then a worst case value of less than 100 Ohm / Volt is assumed.
Given the failure, when the assumption is applied, then it covers both the internal and the external values.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner will be compatible with a wide range of web browsers and devices commonly used by kids and their parents/guardians.
rationale: "A wide range" and "commonly used" are not specific enough to test.
clarification_questions: Which browsers and devices make up "a wide range"?

requirement_text: Colleges shall be able to register for exams at any time.
user_story: As a college administrator, I want to register for exams at any time, so that I am not limited by a registration window.
technical_task: Allow colleges to register for exams without a time restriction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a college, when it registers for an exam at any time of day, then the registration is accepted.
Given a college, when it registers on any day, then the registration is accepted.

requirement_text: The system shall confirm the successful creation of a new user account.
user_story: As a new user, I want confirmation that my account was created, so that I know registration worked.
technical_task: Show a confirmation after a user account is created successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful account creation, when it completes, then a confirmation is shown.
Given a failed account creation, when it ends, then no success confirmation is shown.

requirement_text: The application shall be easy to maintain, with access restricted to a select group of authorized personnel to maintain integrity.
rationale: "Easy to maintain" is subjective and the authorized group is not named.
clarification_questions: What makes the application "easy to maintain" in measurable terms?
Which personnel form the "select group" and what access do they get?

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add a title for the new task.
user_story: As a user, I want to add a title to a new task, so that I can recognize it later.
technical_task: Add a title field to the new task form.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new task form, when the user enters a title and saves, then the task is saved with that title.
Given a saved task, when the user views it, then the title is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to purchase products using a valid credit card.
user_story: As a customer, I want to purchase products with a valid credit card, so that I can pay for my order.
technical_task: Accept valid credit cards as payment for product purchases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid credit card, when the customer pays, then the purchase is completed.
Given an invalid credit card, when the customer pays, then the purchase is not completed.

requirement_text: The website should have an African feel but should not alienate non-Africans. The website should use animation on pages which are describing the services to grab the users attention and encourage them to sign up.
requirement_text_raw: The website should have an African feel  but should not alienate non-Africans.  The website should use animation on pages which are describing the services  to grab the users attention and encourage them to sign up.'
rationale: "African feel", "alienate" and "grab attention" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes a website feel African without alienating non-Africans?
Which pages need animation, and how is attention measured?

requirement_text: Verification department employees shall verify and approve or disapprove applications upon receiving requests from agents.
user_story: As a verification officer, I want to verify and approve or disapprove applications when agents send requests, so that applications are checked.
technical_task: Let verification department employees verify applications received from agents and approve or disapprove them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request from an agent, when a verification department employee reviews the application, then the employee can verify it.
Given a verified application, when the employee decides, then the application is approved or disapproved.
rationale: Role stated: verification department employee and agent.

requirement_text: User shall enter the received OTP.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter the OTP I received, so that I can complete verification.
technical_task: Provide a field where the user enters the received OTP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an OTP has been sent, when the user enters it in the field, then the system accepts the entry for checking.
Given the OTP field, when the user leaves it empty and submits, then the system asks for the OTP.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Validating the OTP is covered by a separate requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a backup and automatic restore facility using an online cloud database to store all user data upon permission, with the ability to restore the information on any device.
user_story: As a user, I want my data backed up to an online cloud database with my permission and restorable on any device, so that I don't lose it.
technical_task: Provide backup and automatic restore using an online cloud database for all user data with the user's permission, restorable on any device.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user gives permission, when a backup runs, then all user data is stored in the online cloud database.
Given a backup exists, when the user restores it on any device, then the information is restored.

requirement_text: System shall let the administrator add/remove categories on the website in under 5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: System shall let the administrator add/remove categories on the website in under 5 minutes.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add or remove categories on the website in under 5 minutes, so that updates are quick.
technical_task: Ensure adding or removing a website category takes the administrator less than 5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the administrator, when a category is added, then the task takes under 5 minutes.
Given the administrator, when a category is removed, then the task takes under 5 minutes.

requirement_text: A state change must only happen if the change condition is true longer than 50 milliseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a state change to occur only when the change condition has been true for longer than 50 milliseconds, so that short glitches are ignored.
technical_task: Debounce state changes so they take effect only after the change condition holds for more than 50 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change condition that is true for longer than 50 milliseconds, when the time passes, then the state change happens.
Given a change condition that is true for no more than 50 milliseconds, when the time passes, then no state change happens.

requirement_text: Memory scrubbing shall be executed without interfering with normal execution of applications tasks.
requirement_text_raw: Memory scrubbing shall (3.3.8.5) be executed without interfering with normal execution of applications tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory scrubbing to run without interfering with the normal execution of application tasks, so that tasks are not disturbed.
technical_task: Run memory scrubbing so that it does not interfere with the normal execution of application tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory scrubbing is running, when application tasks execute, then they execute normally.
Given memory scrubbing is running, when it is compared with a run without scrubbing, then application task execution is not interfered with.

requirement_text: The system shall notify customers about the status of their insurance policies.
user_story: As a policyholder, I want to be notified about the status of my insurance policies, so that I know where they stand.
technical_task: Notify customers about the status of their insurance policies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a policy, when its status changes, then the customer is notified.
Given a customer with several policies, when statuses change, then the customer is notified about each policy.
rationale: Role assumed: policyholder. The notification channel is not stated.
